Vendored for docs/architecture/, pinned. No CDN, no build step for the page.

Fetched with `npm pack <pkg>@<version>` and copied file for file. three and
gsap were minified one file at a time with esbuild 0.28.2
(`--minify --legal-comments=inline --format=esm`, no bundling), so every
module keeps its own name, imports and licence comment; lenis and motion are
copied unchanged.

three 0.186.1        MIT (three/LICENSE)
  three/three.core.js       <- build/three.core.js
  three/three.module.js     <- build/three.module.js
  three/OrbitControls.js    <- examples/jsm/controls/OrbitControls.js

gsap 3.15.0          GreenSock standard licence, https://gsap.com/standard-license
                     (licence header kept in each file)
  gsap/index.js, gsap-core.js, CSSPlugin.js, ScrollTrigger.js, Observer.js,
  SplitText.js      <- the package's root ES modules

lenis 1.3.26         MIT (lenis/LICENSE)
  lenis/lenis.mjs           <- dist/lenis.mjs

motion 13.4.6        MIT (motion/LICENSE.md)
  motion/motion.js          <- dist/motion.js (the single-file browser build)
  motion/index.js           a two-line ES module shim over it (ours)
